# Upstream: grilling

The planner's interview method in `src/devloop/templates/agents/planner.md` is
adapted, in our own words, from Matt Pocock's `grilling` skill (used by
`grill-with-docs`): rounds of questions over a design tree, each with a
recommended answer worded so "yes" accepts it, and facts looked up rather than asked.
